`lib/prompt-template-defs.js` and the budget test change in almost every merge: rebase, then re-measure. Its fixture passes no context (the empty-context branch), so dropping one can raise a ceiling while real renders shrink (LIN-4393).

`lib/prompt-template-defs.js` cannot import what imports `lib/prompt-templates.js` (a cycle): shared words live in a leaf that imports only leaves, as `lib/prompts/leftover-words.js` (LIN-4376; it imports only the import-free `area-registry-path.js`, LIN-4469) and `lib/prompts/autopilot-precedence.js` (never restate a rank; LIN-4382).
A stage lead's first sentence is the selector's purpose line: changing it means new router snapshots, `scripts/eval/meta-prompt.baseline.txt` and routing ceiling (LIN-4369).

A token minted for a stage carries its `writes` and ticket, or has a reason not to. Pass both into the mint helpers (`lib/proxy-preamble.js`), or read them from the row (`lib/item-stage-stamp.js`). A wake, immediate or held, takes the stamp of the session it resumes, the parent, not the row that reported (`stampForWakeParent`; a held release gets the producing build's id from the store). A mint with neither is unrestricted, which is right only for a person's or a `custom` mint, listed with its reason in `tests/unit/dispatch-entrance-mint-sweep.test.js`. The refire broker minted unrestricted tokens for read-only rows because its mint was a bare `createToken`, which no helper-name search finds (LIN-4468).

`tests/fixtures/lin-4467-witness.js` is a permanent ratchet, not a one-off: it pins a sha256 for every real-context render and table, so any stage wording change regenerates `tests/fixtures/lin-4467-witness.json` alongside the byte ceilings and the change log. The budget caps run over a context-free fixture and cannot stand in for it (LIN-4469).
